items.title: 4.1.8.4 Types of Graphs; Graph Implementation Using Python (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of types of graphs (PDF 114-116).

items: Directed graph: edges ki simt hoti hai; shehar A se B tabhi ja sakte hain jab edge usi taraf ho (Figure 4.11).
Undirected graph: edges dono taraf; A B ka dost hai to B A ka dost hai (Figure 4.12).
Weighted graph: har edge ka weight jaise faasla, waqt ya laagat, jo sab se chhota ya tez raasta dhoondne mein madad deta hai (Figure 4.11).

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: A se E par directed weighted graph, teer B se A 10, A se C 12, C se B 20, A se D 60, C se D 32 aur E se A 7. Oopar daen: undirected graph jis ke edges A-B, A-E, B-E, B-D, B-C, C-D aur E-D. Neeche baen: tree jis ki jarr 1, bachche 2, 3, 4, phir 2 ke neeche 5 aur 6, 3 ke neeche 7, 4 ke neeche 8 aur 9, DFS aur BFS tarteebon ke saath. Neeche daen: stack, queue, list, tree ya graph kab istemal karein.
blocks.caption: Graphs, DFS aur BFS, aur structure ka intikhab (topics 4.1.8 se 4.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Directed weighted graph mein har edge ek taraf jata aur laagat rakhta hai, maslan A se D 60, jabke A se C se D 12 + 32 = 44. Undirected graph mein har edge dono taraf chalta hai; B A, C, D aur E se jura hai, to us ki degree 4 hai. Nau nodes wale tree par stack wala DFS pehle gehrai mein jata hai: 1, 2, 5, 6, 3, 7, 4, 8, 9, jabke queue wala BFS level ba level: 1 se 9 tarteeb se. Aakhir mein aa kar pehle jane wale kaam ke liye stack, pehle aa kar pehle jane wale ke liye queue, tarteeb wale majmooe ke liye list, darja-bandi ke liye tree aur networks ke liye graph chunein.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
import networkx as nx
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
G = nx.Graph()          # create a graph
G.add_node("A")
G.add_node("B")
G.add_node("C")
G.add_edge("A", "B")     # add edges
G.add_edge("B", "C")
nx.draw(G, with_labels=True)
plt.show()
Code NetworkX library se teen nodes aur do edges wala graph banata aur Matplotlib se banata hai (dono install hone chahiyein).

blocks.prompt: Directed weighted graph (B se A 10, A se C 12, C se B 20, A se D 60, C se D 32, E se A 7) mein E se D tak sab se sasta raasta kya hai?
blocks.explanation: E se A se C se D: 7 + 12 + 32 = 51, jo E se A se D, 7 + 60 = 67, se sasta hai.

items: Graph ki qismein: directed (ek taraf), undirected (dono taraf), weighted (laagat); NetworkX graphs banata aur khenchta hai.
